edits.old: Then the same holds for an approval, a rollback, a dry run and an evaluation
edits.new:
Then the same holds for an approval, a rollback, a dry run and an evaluation

  Scenario: AC11 Error answers 401 and 404 are given for the provided operations and never an authorised answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller holds no valid credential for POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise
    When the authorise operation is called without a valid credential
    Then the response is 401 with authorised false and no entryRef
    When the authorise operation is called on a path that the provided operations do not contain
    Then the response is 404 with no authorised answer
    Then no access-log entry is written for either call

  Scenario: AC12 A redelivered event is applied once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an event is consumed once by this service, with the event name Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P4-E2042-APP-AC12)
    Given the same event is delivered again
    When the duplicate delivery is consumed
    Then the duplicate changes no state and writes no second access-log entry
    Then the answer already given for the first delivery stands unchanged

edits.old: | TC-E2-042-08 | BR7 | Component | A new role, a new capability area value and a new matrix version added as rows; the authorise answer changes with the rows and no code is changed |
edits.new:
| TC-E2-042-08 | BR7 | Component | A new role, a new capability area value and a new matrix version added as rows; the authorise answer changes with the rows and no code is changed |
| TC-E2-042-09 | AC11 | Contract | POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise called with no valid credential (401) and on a path outside the provided operations (404); no authorised answer and no access-log entry in either case |
| TC-E2-042-10 | AC12 | Component | An event consumed once is delivered again; the duplicate changes no state, writes no second access-log entry and the first answer stands |

disposition.change: Added AC11 (401 and 404 error answers for the provided operations) to section 7 and TC-E2-042-09 to section 16.
disposition.note: AC11 covers 401 and 404 on the authorise operation with no authorised answer and no entry. Event and message IDs for these codes are not specified in the source documents.

disposition.change: Added AC12 (a redelivered consumed event is applied once) to section 7 and TC-E2-042-10 to section 16.
disposition.note: AC12 states a redelivered event changes no state and writes no second entry. The event name is not specified in the source documents, so it is left as a placeholder.
